notes: Room situations for the dungeons in dungeons-1.json (Plan 6 D5): site situations with room: true, played only in a delve and never on the road or at an ordinary site. DCs and wounds are written at standard difficulty; the engine rebases DCs to the dungeon's CR and doubles wounds. Ids start with their dungeon's id. A failed or critically failed room that ends the encounter drives the party out of the dungeon (no hoard; the site can be retried another time), so failure texts describe being driven back. The last room of each dungeon is a skill challenge sized by the dungeon's CR (3 successes before 2 failures up to CR 5, 4 before 3 up to CR 12, 5 before 3 above), whose win pays the hoard and whose loss drives the party out.

start.text: A bandit lookout dozes on the ledge above the stream, a cow-horn on a cord round his neck.

options.label: Slip past along the bank
options.description: Quiet, but a slip wakes him and the whole den.

fail.text: A stone turns underfoot. The lookout jerks awake and blows a long, braying note, and the whole den comes running. You fall back to the cave mouth.

partial.text: {actor} gets everyone past. He stirs, scratches and sleeps on.

success.text: {actor} leads you past so quietly he never even snores the louder.

options.label: Pull him down before he can blow
options.description: Silences him for good, if you are quick.

fail.text: He gets a knife into {actor} and the horn to his lips. The den wakes, and you drag {actor} back out of the cave.

partial.text: {actor} drags him off the ledge, and takes a kick in the ribs for it.

success.text: {actor} has him off the ledge and gagged in one move. His purse is lighter now.

options.label: Toss him a purse to look away
options.description: Costs 5 gp, risks nothing.

outcome.text: He weighs the purse, grins, and goes back to sleep with one eye open.

start.text: The bank has slumped into the stream. For a dozen yards the path runs through icy, knee-deep water over slick stones.

options.label: Wade it
options.description: Quick and cold.

fail.text: {actor} is swept back to the near bank, numb and bruised, and you give up the crossing.

partial.text: You splash through, cold to the bone.

success.text: {actor} finds the firm stones and walks everyone across dry-shod.

options.label: Edge along the rock above
options.description: Dry, if nobody falls.

fail.text: {actor} slips and lands hard in the water, and the current carries them back out of the cave.

partial.text: A scrape, a curse, and you are over.

success.text: {actor} finds every handhold, and from up there spots the den ahead.

options.label: Lay planks from the woodpile across it
options.description: Uses 1 timber.

outcome.text: You drop a few planks across the worst of it and walk over.

start.text: Two bandits are sorting the take by lamplight. In the cages beside them three half-starved hounds leap up, barking.

options.label: Rush them before they open the cages
options.description: Speed against blades and teeth. Too slow, and you face both.

fail.text: One gets a cage open. Teeth and knives both find {actor}, and you fall back the way you came.

partial.text: {actor} knocks one flat; the other runs, leaving a gash behind.

success.text: {actor} has them both down before a latch is lifted.

options.label: Hush the hounds
options.description: Quiet dogs, and maybe the bandits lose heart.

fail.text: The hounds bay louder. The bandits come at you swinging and drive you out of the hollow.

partial.text: The hounds quiet down, but one bandit slips off to warn the rest.

success.text: The hounds wag their tails at {actor}. Alone, the bandits throw down their clubs and their purses.

options.label: Throw the hounds meat from your packs
options.description: Uses 1 food.

outcome.text: The hounds fall on the meat. The bandits, outnumbered, bolt into the dark.

start.text: The sacks heave. Rats as big as dogs, fat on stolen grain, boil out of the trapdoor and the heaps.

options.label: Stamp and swing
options.description: Beat back the swarm by hand. If it breaks you, it bites everyone.

fail.text: They swarm up legs and arms, and you flee the sorting floor slapping them off.

partial.text: {actor} beats them back, bitten twice.

success.text: {actor} breaks the swarm and drives it down the trapdoor.

options.label: Slam the trapdoor on them
options.description: Shut off the nest, if you can reach it.

fail.text: {actor} trips on a sack, and the rats pour over everyone. You run for the cave mouth.

partial.text: {actor} gets it shut on half of them. The rest are soon dealt with.

success.text: {actor} slams the trapdoor and sits on it. The few left outside run.

start.text: A merchant's boy sits gagged in the iron cage, eyes wide. The crew is holding him for ransom.

options.label: Pick the lock
options.description: Quiet work, if your fingers stay steady.

fail.text: The pick snaps and the lock rattles loudly. Footsteps come running, and you slip back out before they arrive.

partial.text: It takes a while, but the door swings open.

success.text: {actor} has him out in a breath. He whispers where the captain sits and how many guard her.

critSuccess.text: {actor} has him out at once. Grateful, he tells you where the captain keeps a spare purse.

options.label: Wrench the door off its hinges
options.description: Faster than a pick, and loud however it goes.

fail.text: The hinges hold, the cage clangs, and {actor} wrenches a shoulder. The noise sends you back out.

partial.text: The door tears free with a screech. The boy runs for the cave mouth.

success.text: {actor} lifts the door off its pins. The boy points the way and slips out.

options.label: Leave him for now
options.description: Saves time; the party will not like it.

outcome.text: You promise to come back for him. He watches you go.

start.text: Half the crew is asleep here, snoring under their blankets, weapons by their heads.

options.label: Creep through
options.description: Quiet, and maybe a little profit.

fail.text: Someone treads on a hand. In a moment the hall is a brawl, and you fight your way back out.

partial.text: You get through. Behind you a sleeper mutters and turns over.

success.text: {actor} leads you through, lifting a purse or two on the way.

options.label: Bind them in their sleep
options.description: Fewer blades later, if your hands are deft.

fail.text: The second one wakes with a yell and a knife, and the whole hall drives you out.

partial.text: Two are trussed; the rest flee half-dressed into the dark.

success.text: {actor} trusses the lot without waking a single one.

options.label: Bar the door and go the long way round
options.description: Safe from them, but tiring.

outcome.text: You wedge the door and take the long, low way through the rock. It is hard going.

start.text: The bandit captain kicks back her chair and draws two long knives. Her last few loyalists close up behind her. 'You've cost me a night's sleep.'

options.label: Fight her at the table
options.description: Steel against her two knives, straight up.

fail.text: Her knives are quicker than they look. {actor} reels back, bleeding.

partial.text: A long, ugly scuffle across the table. A loyalist goes down, and so does some of your blood.

success.text: {actor} pins her knife hand to the table, and she has to tear it free.

options.label: Kick the kegs over into them
options.description: Sure to knock them flat, and sure to hurt.

fail.text: {actor} slips on the spilled ale and takes a knife in the leg.

partial.text: The kegs bowl two of them over, and {actor} goes down in the ale with them.

success.text: The kegs crash into them. {actor} is on the captain before she is up, bruised from the tumble.

options.label: Stare her crew down
options.description: Break their nerve and leave her open, or face them all.

fail.text: They laugh, and come at {actor} together.

partial.text: They look at each other, and stay where they are.

success.text: {actor}'s look is enough. Her crew edge back from the table, and she fights alone.

win.text: The captain drops her knives and yields. Her crew are already gone into the dark.

lose.text: Her crew close in around the table, and you are chased out along the stream with their jeers behind you.

start.text: Every strand across the passage is a line to something further in. Touch one and the whole hollow will know.

options.label: Cut the strands one by one
options.description: Slow and careful.

fail.text: A strand twangs as it parts. Far off, something stops moving, and you back out before it comes looking.

partial.text: Slowly, strand by strand, you open a way.

success.text: {actor} parts them without a tremor. Whatever waits doesn't know you're here.

options.label: Duck and push through
options.description: Quicker than cutting. One wrong step and the hollow wakes.

fail.text: {actor} blunders into a sheet of web and has to be cut free and carried back out, sticky and scratched.

partial.text: You get through with web in your hair. Probably nothing noticed.

success.text: {actor} weaves under and over every strand and waves you through.

options.label: Burn a way through
options.description: Uses 1 fuel. Nothing is left to trip.

outcome.text: The web shrivels in a hiss of flame. The smoke drifts ahead of you into the dark.

start.text: The web overhead sags. Three spiders the size of dogs drop on their threads, legs spread.

options.label: Cut them down
options.description: Meet them blade first as they drop.

fail.text: A bite in the neck leaves {actor} numb and staggering, and you carry them back out.

partial.text: {actor} hacks two apart; the third bites before it dies.

success.text: {actor} cuts them out of the air one after another.

options.label: Watch the web and step aside
options.description: Read the threads before they fall.

fail.text: You look up too late, and flee the hollow with the spiders dropping after you.

partial.text: {actor} calls the drop and you scatter. They land, and you fight them on the ground.

success.text: {actor} sees the threads tighten, and the spiders land on nothing but your blades.

start.text: One of the hanging bundles twitches, and a muffled voice comes from inside it.

options.label: Cut it down and free them
options.description: A life, if you can save it.

fail.text: It's a woodcutter, half-dissolved by venom and past saving. {actor} nicks a hand on a poisoned fang in the wrappings, and you turn back.

partial.text: A pale woodcutter falls out, gasping thanks, and staggers off to the light.

success.text: {actor} gets the woodcutter out and his blood moving. He knows the caverns' turns, and tells you.

options.label: Leave it hanging
options.description: Quick, but the party will not forget it.

outcome.text: You walk on. The voice follows you for a long time.

start.text: A dead traveller's pack hangs at the very centre of the web, buckles glinting.

options.label: Climb out to the hub
options.description: The whole prize, if you keep your feet.

fail.text: {actor} sticks fast halfway and has to be cut free, sore and gummed, as the spiders come. You flee.

partial.text: {actor} gets there and back with the pack.

success.text: {actor} walks the spokes like a rope-dancer and brings back the pack, whole.

options.label: Cut the web down from the edge
options.description: Safe, tiring, and some of it is lost.

outcome.text: It takes a long time hacking at the cables, but the pack comes down, half of it spilling into the dark.
You leave the pack to the web and go on.

start.text: The eggs are cracking. A tide of spiderlings, each the size of a hand, pours across the floor towards your warmth.

options.label: Stamp and smash
options.description: Hold the floor against the tide. Everyone stands in it.

fail.text: They swarm everyone, biting, and you run for the way out.

partial.text: {actor} crushes the front of the tide. The rest scatter, after a few bites.

success.text: {actor} wades in, stamping, and the tide breaks.

options.label: Run for the far tunnel
options.description: Leave the tide behind, if the sticky floor lets you.

fail.text: {actor} trips in the sticky floor, and they swarm over. You drag them out of the hollow.

partial.text: You get clear, picking spiderlings off your clothes as you go.

success.text: {actor} finds a clean line through and you are gone before they reach you.

options.label: Burn the clutch
options.description: Uses 1 fuel.

outcome.text: The eggs go up with a crackle and a foul smell. Nothing follows you out.

start.text: The funnel shivers. A spider the size of a cart heaves out of the hole, venom dripping from fangs as long as daggers.

options.label: Hold the mouth of the funnel
options.description: Meet her head-on as she comes out of the hole.

fail.text: Her fangs sink into {actor}, and the venom burns like fire.

partial.text: A hard fight on sticky ground, and her legs reach everyone.

success.text: {actor} drives a blade into her face as she comes out of the hole. She pulls back, hissing.

options.label: Strike where her legs join
options.description: You know where she is weak. Getting close costs blood.

fail.text: {actor} gets in close and misses the joint. Her legs fold round them.

partial.text: {actor} hacks at a leg. It holds, and a fang grazes them.

success.text: {actor} knows spiders. A leg comes away at the joint, and a fang grazes them as she lurches.

options.label: Lure her out into the open
options.description: Fight her on your ground, if she bites.

fail.text: She does not take the bait. She comes from above instead, onto {actor}.

partial.text: She twitches, and waits.

success.text: {actor} twitches a thread like a struggling fly. She rushes out straight onto your blades.

options.label: Throw alchemist's fire into the funnel
options.description: Uses 1 alchemicals. A sure blow, once.

outcome.text: The funnel goes up like dry straw. She comes out burning and thrashing, and lashes about her.

win.text: The brood mother curls up on her own legs and dies, and the hollow goes quiet.

lose.text: She drives you back up the webbed throat, and you flee the hollow with her clicking behind you.

start.text: The rune in the floor is a ward. The air above it prickles like a coming storm.

options.label: Read the ward
options.description: The old god may favour those who know its ways.

fail.text: {actor} misreads it and steps in. The ward's shock throws them back, and the way stays shut.

partial.text: {actor} works out where it is safe to step.

success.text: {actor} reads the war god's ward and speaks its word. It lets you pass, and warms to you.

options.label: Climb round it over the rubble
options.description: The long way round, over loose stone.

fail.text: The rubble shifts, {actor} slides onto the rune, and the shock hurls them back out the door.

partial.text: A slow scramble over loose stone, but you get round.

success.text: {actor} finds a path round the hall, and from there sees the gallery beyond.

options.label: Just walk across
options.description: Everyone takes a jolt.

outcome.text: A cold shock runs through everyone, and then the ward is spent.

start.text: As you pass the second pair of statues, gilt cracks. Two of the champions step down from their plinths, empty armour moving on its own.

options.label: Break them apart
options.description: Steel and muscle against gilded armour.

fail.text: A gilded fist sends {actor} into the wall, and you retreat with them.

partial.text: {actor} batters them to pieces, and takes a few blows doing it.

success.text: {actor} knocks the helms off and the armour falls in a heap.

options.label: Kneel as a worshipper would
options.description: Their old orders may still hold.

fail.text: They are not fooled. Gilded blades come down, and you flee the hall.

partial.text: They hesitate long enough for you to slip past.

success.text: {actor} kneels and gives the war god's salute. The champions step back onto their plinths.

options.label: Fight, and pry the gilt off as you go
options.description: Profit, if you can fight and steal at once.

fail.text: Greed costs {actor} dearly: a blow lands while their hands are full, and you flee empty-handed.

partial.text: A few flakes of gold, bought with bruises.

success.text: {actor} strips them as they fall: good gold leaf.

start.text: The skeletons sit up in their coffins, reaching for the axes laid beside them.

options.label: Smash them before they stand
options.description: Strike fast, while they are still lying down.

fail.text: An axe bites {actor}, and the bones keep coming. You fall back out of the temple.

partial.text: {actor} breaks one; the other takes some breaking.

success.text: {actor} smashes both skulls before they are out of their coffins.

options.label: Command them to rest
options.description: Lay them to rest, if your voice carries.

fail.text: They do not heed. Axes swing, and you are driven back out.

partial.text: One lies down; the other fights on, alone and slower.

success.text: {actor} speaks the rites of the honoured dead, and they lie back down, at peace.

start.text: Robed cultists kneel before the idol, chanting. One turns, sees you, and the chant falters.

options.label: Break up the rite
options.description: Charge in while they kneel. Fanatics fight hard.

fail.text: They fight like fanatics, and their knives find {actor}. You are driven from the temple.

partial.text: A short, savage fight in the narrow shrine.

success.text: {actor} is among them before they rise. They scatter, robes flapping.

options.label: Pose as late worshippers
options.description: Get past without a fight, if they believe you.

fail.text: Nobody knows your faces. The knives come out, and you run.

partial.text: They are suspicious, but let you kneel at the back, and you slip out the far side.

success.text: {actor} mumbles the chant and gets the priest's trust, and with it the way into the hall.

options.label: Topple the idol
options.description: Break their faith, if your back holds.

fail.text: The idol does not budge. The cultists turn on {actor} and chase you all out.

partial.text: The idol rocks and falls. The fight that follows is short and bitter.

success.text: The idol smashes on the floor. The cultists wail and flee, their heart broken.

start.text: The cult's priest stands on the haft of the glowing axe, drinking its light. His guards lower their spears.

options.label: Cut through his guards
options.description: Steel through spears to reach the priest.

fail.text: The priest's stolen light burns {actor} to the bone.

partial.text: A hard exchange across the shining floor. A guard falls, and so does some of your blood.

success.text: {actor} drives through the guards and the priest gives ground.

options.label: Break his hold on the axe
options.description: Turn the light against him, and leave him open.

fail.text: The light lashes out at the one who meddles.

partial.text: His hold slips, then catches again.

success.text: {actor} tears a share of the light from him. He blinks, half blind.

options.label: Stand on the blade and swear to the old god
options.description: A long shot, and a glorious one.

fail.text: The god is silent, and the priest laughs as he strikes.

partial.text: The axe glows brighter, then dims again.

success.text: The old war god answers {actor}, and the light runs warm over your wounds.

critSuccess.text: The old war god answers {actor} in a voice like a war-horn. The light runs warm over you all.

win.text: The priest goes down on the haft of the axe, and his guards flee the temple.

lose.text: The priest's light drives you back across the floor and out of the temple. He does not follow.

start.text: Old soot stains the bowl, and the pebbles round it are laid in the shape of a sun. The temple is dark and very quiet.

options.label: Kindle the sacred fire
options.description: Uses 1 fuel.

outcome.text: The flame catches, and a warm light runs along the walls ahead like dawn. You feel welcome here.

options.label: Study the pebble sun
options.description: The pattern may tell you how the dead were honoured. Careless hands could wake something.

fail.text: {actor} disturbs the pattern. Somewhere deeper, stone grinds on stone, and sand pours from the ceiling. You scramble back out.

partial.text: A sun prayer, and an old one. Nothing more to learn.

success.text: {actor} reads the rite in the pebbles: the dead here fear fire and honour the dawn.

outcome.text: You leave the bowl cold and go on.

start.text: The sand ripples where no wind blows. A giant scorpion bursts up in a spray of grit, tail arched.

options.label: Fight it in the drift
options.description: Stand and fight in shifting sand, sting and all.

fail.text: The sting finds {actor}, and the poison burns. You carry them back to the surface.

partial.text: Wading and hacking, you kill it, but its claws reach a few of you.

success.text: {actor} pins the tail and cracks the shell.

options.label: Keep to the high ground of the drift
options.description: Stay on the ridge above it, if the sand stays put.

fail.text: The sand slides away under {actor}, right into its claws. You pull them free and run.

partial.text: You cross on the ridge, and it loses you.

success.text: {actor} finds the firm crest. It follows below, and you strike down on it.

options.label: Splash water to draw it off
options.description: Uses 1 water.

outcome.text: It goes mad for the wet sand and you skirt round it.

start.text: As you step between the pillars the sunstone flares, bright as noon and hot as a forge.

options.label: Shade your eyes and feel your way
options.description: Cross half-blind, reading what the glare leaves you.

fail.text: Blinded, {actor} walks into a pillar and the heat blisters skin. You lead them back out by the hand.

partial.text: Squinting through your fingers, you cross the court.

success.text: {actor} reads the shadows of the pillars and leads you along them, out of the glare.

options.label: Throw a cloak over the stone
options.description: Smother the light at its source, if your throw is true.

fail.text: {actor} misses, and the cloak catches fire. So does a sleeve. You retreat to beat out the flames.

partial.text: The cloak smoulders but holds long enough.

success.text: The court goes dark at once. {actor} pockets a shard that broke from its edge.

options.label: Pray in the sun's light
options.description: Its blessing, if it hears you.

fail.text: The sun does not know you. The heat beats you down and back out of the hall.

partial.text: The light softens and lets you through.

success.text: The light washes over you like morning, and your wounds close.

start.text: As you near the altar the braziers rise, flames shaping themselves into two burning figures.

options.label: Fight the fire
options.description: Steel against living flame. Expect burns.

fail.text: The burning hands close on {actor}. You drag them back out, smoking.

partial.text: You beat them to embers, scorched all over.

success.text: {actor} scatters them into sparks.

options.label: Snatch the crystal from the altar
options.description: They may be bound to it.

fail.text: {actor} grabs, and the flames grab back. You flee the hall.

partial.text: {actor} has it. Without it the flames sink back into their bowls, spitting.

success.text: {actor} lifts it clean. The flames gutter and die, and the crystal is worth keeping.

options.label: Douse the braziers
options.description: Uses 2 water; the steam scalds.

outcome.text: The water hisses into steam, and the figures die with a shriek.

start.text: The golden lid swings open. The priest-king steps out in his wrappings, sun mask gleaming, and his rotting curse fills the air.

options.label: Cut him down
options.description: Hew at him directly, curse and all.

fail.text: His touch withers {actor} to the bone.

partial.text: A slow, terrible fight among the jars, and his curse reaches everyone.

success.text: {actor} hews through the wrappings, and dust pours from the wound.

options.label: Smash the jars that hold his heart
options.description: Each one breaks with a breath of his curse.

fail.text: {actor} smashes the wrong jars, and each one breathes out his curse.

partial.text: A jar breaks, and its curse is breathed in by all.

success.text: {actor} finds the right jar and smashes it. He shudders, and the curse it held is breathed in by all.

options.label: Send him back to his rest
options.description: He was a sun priest once.

fail.text: He laughs dust, and strikes {actor} down.

partial.text: He pauses at the prayer, then comes on.

success.text: {actor} speaks the dawn prayer, and the priest-king staggers back against his coffin.

options.label: Set his wrappings alight
options.description: Uses 1 alchemicals. A sure blow, once.

outcome.text: He burns like old paper, shrieking, and gropes blindly for anyone near.

win.text: The priest-king falls to dust among his jars, and the sun mask rolls ringing across the floor.

lose.text: His curse drives you back up through the sand and into the sun. He lets you go.

start.text: Three gnolls squat round the spit, tearing at the meat. Their ears go up as one.

options.label: Take them at the fire
options.description: Strike while they eat. The rest of the warren may hear.

fail.text: A spear goes into {actor}, and more gnolls come running. You fall back out of the warren.

partial.text: A snarling brawl round the fire. You win it.

success.text: {actor} kicks the spit into them and finishes them in the smoke.

options.label: Wait for them to sleep off the meal
options.description: Patience might pay.

fail.text: One smells you and howls the pack awake, and you run for the way out.

partial.text: They doze off at last. You slip by, slowly.

success.text: {actor} keeps you hidden until they snore, then you pass and take their stores.

start.text: The plank walks sway and creak. Some boards are missing; others look sawn half through.

options.label: Cross by the planks
options.description: Trust the boards, and choose which ones.

fail.text: A board snaps. {actor} goes in to the chest and is dragged back out, gasping and bruised. There is no crossing today.

partial.text: You cross, testing every board.

success.text: {actor} spots the gnolls' sawn boards and leads you over the sound ones.

options.label: Wade the shallow edge of the pit
options.description: Slow and filthy, but there are no boards to break.

fail.text: The mud takes {actor} to the waist, and getting back out is hard work. You give up the crossing.

partial.text: A filthy, slow wade.

success.text: {actor} finds the firm bottom and you all squelch across.

options.label: Lay new boards
options.description: Uses 1 timber.

outcome.text: You lay your own timber across the gaps and walk over.

start.text: The pack is home: half a dozen gnolls round the fire, cackling over a game of knucklebones.

options.label: Charge the fire
options.description: Hit the whole pack at once, before they arm.

fail.text: They swarm {actor}, biting, and you fight your way back out.

partial.text: A wild fight among the tents.

success.text: {actor} hits them before they find their spears. The rest flee into the dark.

options.label: Set the tents alight
options.description: Fire and panic, if nobody sees you.

fail.text: They see {actor} creeping and drag them into the firelight. You cut them loose and run.

partial.text: The tents catch. In the smoke you fight them off.

success.text: The hides go up in a roar. The pack bolts, howling, and you walk through the camp.

options.label: Answer their cackle with a challenge
options.description: Gnolls follow the strongest.

fail.text: They laugh, and chase you out of the warren.

partial.text: Half of them slink off. The rest fight.

success.text: {actor} roars like a bigger beast. The pack scatters, tails down.

start.text: The chasm is narrowest where the gnolls jump it: a long stride for a gnoll, a long leap for you.

options.label: Jump it
options.description: One long leap each. Quick, if nobody falls short.

fail.text: {actor} falls short, catches the edge and is hauled back, bloody to the elbows. You turn back.

partial.text: You all make it, some with help.

success.text: {actor} jumps first and catches each of the others.

options.label: Rig a rope across
options.description: Safer than leaping, but it takes work.

fail.text: The rope slips. {actor} slams into the far wall and has to be hauled back. You give up the crossing.

partial.text: It takes time, but the rope holds.

success.text: {actor} finds a spur of rock to tie to, and you cross easily.

options.label: Take the long way round
options.description: Safe, but tiring.

outcome.text: Hours of narrow tunnels, but you come out on the far side.

start.text: The matriarch rises from her coffin-throne, wearing a crown of finger bones. Her bodyguard of hyenas snarl at her feet.

options.label: Fight her and her hyenas
options.description: Through the pack and at her, the hard way.

fail.text: Her flail and their teeth find {actor} again and again.

partial.text: A hyena goes down, and the rest take their share of you.

success.text: {actor} breaks through the hyenas and lands a blow on her.

options.label: Drive the hyenas off with fire and noise
options.description: They will scatter, but not without a bite.

fail.text: They don't scare. They pull {actor} down.

partial.text: The hyenas scatter and circle back, snapping at {actor}.

success.text: {actor} waves a torch and roars. The hyenas break off, with a parting bite.

options.label: Call her out before her pack
options.description: A long shot. Win, and her pack starts to doubt her.

fail.text: She laughs, and takes {actor} apart in front of her pack.

partial.text: She snarls back. The pack waits to see who wins.

success.text: {actor}'s challenge rings off the coffin. She hesitates, and her pack sees it.

critSuccess.text: {actor}'s challenge rings off the coffin. Her pack backs away from her, and she is alone.

options.label: Feed the hyenas
options.description: Uses 2 food. A sure blow, once.

outcome.text: The hyenas fight each other over your meat, and leave her to face you alone. She makes you pay for it.

win.text: The matriarch falls across her own coffin, crown and all, and her pack slinks away into the warren.

lose.text: The pack closes round you, and you are driven out of the warren with the howling behind.

start.text: The fume pools thick round the grate. Your eyes stream, and the first breath burns.

options.label: Hold your breath and run
options.description: One breath, one dash. Nothing spent but nerve.

fail.text: {actor} gasps halfway across, and the fume gets into the lungs. You drag them back out, retching.

partial.text: You cross coughing.

success.text: {actor} sets the pace and everyone crosses on one breath.

options.label: Breathe through wet cloths
options.description: Uses 1 water.

outcome.text: It stings, but the wet cloths keep the worst out.

options.label: Drink an antidote first
options.description: Uses 1 healing.

outcome.text: The draught tastes vile, but you walk through the fume unharmed.

start.text: The drain grate lifts. A bloated, three-legged thing with an eye on a stalk hauls itself out of the muck, tentacles first.

options.label: Fight it
options.description: Kill it in its own muck. It hits hard.

fail.text: Its tentacles crush {actor}, and its bite festers. You pull them free and flee the sewer.

partial.text: A filthy fight, but it slides back down dead.

success.text: {actor} spears the eye-stalk, and it sinks away.

options.label: Slam the grate back on it
options.description: Shut it in rather than kill it.

fail.text: A tentacle catches {actor} as the grate comes down. You tear them loose and retreat.

partial.text: The grate drops and you hold it there until the thing gives up.

success.text: {actor} drops the grate on it, and you walk on over the bars.

start.text: Masked cultists are stirring the vats with long paddles. They see you, and one lifts a ladle of boiling poison.

options.label: Rush them
options.description: Close in before the ladle swings.

fail.text: The ladle catches {actor} full in the chest, and you are driven back up the tunnels.

partial.text: A scalding fight among the vats.

success.text: {actor} is on them before the ladle swings.

options.label: Tip a vat over them
options.description: Their own brew against them.

fail.text: The vat rocks back. Poison splashes over {actor}, and you flee the fumes.

partial.text: The vat tips. Some of them run, some do not.

success.text: The vat crashes over and the poisoners flee screaming, their masks no help.

options.label: Slip through the hatch behind them
options.description: Skip the fight, if the hatch keeps quiet. Their stores lie that way.

fail.text: The hatch squeals. They turn, ladles raised, and chase you back the way you came.

partial.text: You get through the hatch, and they never knew.

success.text: {actor} gets you through, and lifts a crate of their antidote on the way.

start.text: One of the gargoyle heads blinks. Two stone bodies peel away from the corners above the channel, wings unfolding.

options.label: Fight them
options.description: Blades against stone. Expect bruises.

fail.text: Stone claws tear into {actor}, and you fall back out of the undercroft.

partial.text: Swords ring on stone. You win, chipped and bruised.

success.text: {actor} topples one into the sludge, and the other flees.

options.label: Lure them over the sludge
options.description: Let the poison do the work.

fail.text: {actor} slips into the channel. The sludge burns, and you haul them out and back.

partial.text: One dives too low and the sludge takes it. The other fights.

success.text: {actor} dodges at the brink, and both crash into the sludge.

start.text: The only way on is along the channel, past the sinkhole, where the sludge pulls hard toward the dark.

options.label: Edge along the rim
options.description: Backs to the wall, inches from the pull.

fail.text: {actor} slips into the current and is hauled out burned. You give up the way.

partial.text: A slow shuffle with your backs to the wall.

success.text: {actor} finds the dry stones and you cross clean.

options.label: Fill the gap with rubble
options.description: Build your own way across. Heavy work.

fail.text: Heavy, burning work, and the sludge splashes. In the end you give up and go back.

partial.text: Hard work, but it holds.

success.text: {actor} topples a block across the hole: a bridge.

options.label: Lay a plank bridge
options.description: Uses 1 timber.

outcome.text: Your timber bridges the gap, and you walk over the flood.

start.text: The cult's high priest stands before the red-barred door, arms raised to the falls. The sludge answers: it rises into a heaving mass of ooze that fills the chamber end to end, dissolving the steps it crawls over.

options.label: Hack the ooze apart
options.description: Cut it down piece by piece. It burns what it touches.

fail.text: It swallows {actor} to the shoulders before you drag them free.

partial.text: A piece of it dies, and the spatter burns everyone.

success.text: {actor} cleaves a great lump from it, and it spills away harmless.

options.label: Turn the pipes on it
options.description: Every valve breathes fog as it opens.

fail.text: {actor} opens the wrong valve, and green fog fills the chamber.

partial.text: A gout of water and a gout of fog, both at once.

success.text: {actor} finds the flushing valve. Clean water drives it back into the drains, and the fog comes with it.

options.label: Strike at the priest
options.description: Kill his chant, and his creature falters.

fail.text: The ooze is faster. It closes on {actor}.

partial.text: {actor} slips round the ooze, and the priest backs off behind it.

success.text: {actor} cuts the priest down mid-chant. The ooze heaves blindly.

options.label: Throw alchemist's fire
options.description: Uses 1 alchemicals. A sure blow, once.

outcome.text: It burns with a green flame and a stink to make you retch, and shrinks back.

win.text: The ooze sinks into a stinking puddle, and the priest's chant ends in a gurgle.

lose.text: The filth breaks over you, and you stagger out of the undercroft, choking.

start.text: Halfway across, the ice groans. Dark cracks run out from under your boots.

options.label: Spread out and walk light
options.description: Read the ice and share the weight.

fail.text: The ice gives under {actor}. The water is so cold it stops the breath, and you turn back to warm them.

partial.text: The cracks spread, but hold. You reach the stair, shaking.

success.text: {actor} reads the ice and picks the thick road across.

options.label: Run for the stair
options.description: Speed over care, before the ice decides.

fail.text: {actor} goes through, and is dragged out blue. You turn back.

partial.text: You make the stair as the ice breaks up behind you.

success.text: You reach the stair before the first floe breaks free.

options.label: Clamber round by the rocky shore
options.description: Safe, but tiring.

outcome.text: An hour of icy boulders, but the stair is reached safely.

start.text: Pale wolves the size of ponies rise from the drift in the tower. Their breath smokes with frost.

options.label: Fight them in the doorway
options.description: Fight from the doorway, where they cannot all reach you.

fail.text: Their frozen breath and teeth both find {actor}, and you fall back out of the caves.

partial.text: A long fight in the snow.

success.text: {actor} holds the doorway and they die one at a time.

options.label: Drive them off with fire and noise
options.description: Winter beasts hate flame.

fail.text: The wind snuffs your torches. They come in hard and drive you out.

partial.text: They back off, snarling, and circle away.

success.text: {actor} waves the flame high, and the pack slinks off into the snow.

options.label: Throw them your meat and slip past
options.description: Uses 2 food.

outcome.text: They fall on the meat, and you are past before they finish it.

start.text: The heads breathe in turn, and where their mist falls the grates rime over with ice. You must cross under all of them.

options.label: Time the breaths
options.description: Count the rhythm and move between the gusts.

fail.text: {actor} misjudges, and is caught full in a breath. You drag them back out.

partial.text: You cross in the gaps, with only frostbitten fingers.

success.text: {actor} counts the breaths, and you pass between them dry.

options.label: Push straight through
options.description: Take the cold and keep moving. Fast, and hard on everyone.

fail.text: The cold lays everyone low, and you crawl back the way you came.

partial.text: A hard crossing, but quick.

success.text: {actor} breaks the ice off the grates ahead of you, and you cross fast.

options.label: Stop the heads with their own words
options.description: They are a ward. Wards have words.

fail.text: {actor}'s words make the heads breathe all at once. You flee the frost.

partial.text: Some fall silent. The rest breathe on.

success.text: {actor} speaks to the heads in their maker's tongue, and they close their mouths.

start.text: Three delvers stand frozen to the grate in the last gallery, rime on their eyelashes. One is still breathing, barely.

options.label: Thaw the living one
options.description: Slow work in the cold, for a life.

fail.text: {actor} works too long in the cold and saves no one. You turn back, numb.

partial.text: She lives, and stumbles off for the stair with your blessing.

success.text: She lives, and tells you what guards the heart, and how it fights.

options.label: Search the dead quickly
options.description: Rob the dead quickly. The ice under them is thin.

fail.text: The ice shatters under {actor} into black water. You pull them out and retreat.

partial.text: A purse, frozen solid.

success.text: A purse, a fine dagger and a flask of healing.

outcome.text: You leave them standing in the dark.

start.text: The gallery that leads to the heart is barred by a gate gone solid with ice.

options.label: Break it open
options.description: Hammer at the ice until it gives. Tiring work.

fail.text: {actor} hammers until their hands split, and the gate holds. You turn back.

partial.text: The ice cracks loose at last.

success.text: {actor} finds the weak bar and the gate bursts open.

options.label: Melt it with fire
options.description: Uses 2 fuel.

outcome.text: The ice runs off in a hiss of steam.

options.label: Climb over the gate along the pipes
options.description: Everyone pays a little.

outcome.text: Freezing pipes, burning fingers, but you get over.

start.text: The heart beats once, and the cold doubles. The frost pours from it into a shape: a tall figure of ice, the keeper the temple was built for. The two stone guardians turn their heads to watch.

options.label: Fight the keeper
options.description: Face it blade to blade in the cold.

fail.text: Its icy blade drives through {actor}.

partial.text: A bitter fight in the freezing apse.

success.text: {actor} hacks a limb from it. It grows back slower.

options.label: Keep it chasing you over the ice
options.description: The cold takes its toll on whoever runs.

fail.text: {actor} goes down on the ice, under its blade.

partial.text: {actor} keeps ahead of it, just, past the clawed guardians.

success.text: {actor} leads it a dance under the guardians' claws, and they strike it. The frost bites as it cracks.

options.label: Pick the locks on the heart
options.description: Loosen its hold on the heart, and the keeper weakens.

fail.text: The lock bites cold. The keeper strikes {actor} at the casket.

partial.text: A lock clicks, and holds.

success.text: {actor} springs a lock, and the heart sputters. The keeper falters.

options.label: Burn the heart
options.description: Uses 1 alchemicals. A sure blow, once.

outcome.text: You pour fire on the heart until it cracks. The keeper reels, but not before it strikes.

win.text: The heart goes dark in its chains, and the keeper melts to water on the stair.

lose.text: The cold drives you out of the heart and back into the wind, the keeper's blade behind you.

start.text: Another crew got here first. Their leader steps out from behind a sphinx, crossbows levelled behind him. 'Turn round. This one's ours.'

options.label: Fight for the tomb
options.description: Charge their crossbows. No shares, no talk.

fail.text: Crossbow bolts find {actor}, and the crew drives you back out of the tomb.

partial.text: A running fight among the sphinxes.

success.text: {actor} is among them before the second volley.

options.label: Offer them a share
options.description: A share costs less than blood, maybe.

fail.text: He takes it as weakness. The bolts fly, and you run.

partial.text: They take your gold and leave, grumbling.

success.text: {actor} talks them into going first. They do, and find the traps for you.

options.label: Tell them what waits inside
options.description: Not all of it need be true.

fail.text: They laugh, and shoot you back out of the tomb.

partial.text: Half of them leave. The rest fight, and lose.

success.text: {actor} tells a tale of curses so well that the whole crew runs for their boats.

start.text: The weed in the pools parts. Two crocodiles as long as boats slide out onto the paving, jaws wide.

options.label: Fight them on the paving
options.description: Meet the jaws on dry stone.

fail.text: Jaws close on {actor} and drag them toward the water. You tear them free and flee.

partial.text: A thrashing fight on the wet stones.

success.text: {actor} drives a spear down a throat, and the other slides back into the weed.

options.label: Run between the columns
options.description: Dodge past on the wet stone, using the columns for cover.

fail.text: {actor} slips on the wet stone, and a tail sweeps them flat. You retreat.

partial.text: You run the gauntlet of columns, and reach the far door.

success.text: {actor} weaves through, and the crocodiles crash into stone behind.

options.label: Throw meat into the far pool
options.description: Uses 2 food.

outcome.text: They turn after the meat, and you are through.

start.text: The painted scarab seems to move. Then the real ones pour out of the pillars, thousands of them, clicking.

options.label: Run for the far door
options.description: Outrun the swarm, if you can find a gap.

fail.text: They swarm over {actor} and bite through to the bone. You flee the tomb.

partial.text: You run with beetles in your clothes.

success.text: {actor} leads you through the gap in the swarm, and you slam the door.

options.label: Stand on the winged sun
options.description: The painters knew how to cross it.

fail.text: {actor} guesses wrong, and the swarm closes. You run for the light.

partial.text: The swarm parts round the painted sun, but not cleanly.

success.text: {actor} knows the old rite: the scarabs will not cross the sun. You walk out on it.

options.label: Scatter them with fire
options.description: Uses 2 fuel.

outcome.text: The beetles shrivel and scatter from the flames.

start.text: The statue's eyes open, burning gold. A voice like grinding stone asks your hearts to be weighed.

options.label: Lay your hearts on its scale
options.description: It knows the truth. Be honest.

fail.text: The scale tips. The staff falls on {actor}, and you flee the hall.

partial.text: The scale wavers, and the god lets you pass, uneasily.

success.text: {actor} speaks only the truth. The god bows its head, and its blessing goes with you.

options.label: Recite the funeral rite
options.description: Speak the words it was made to hear. Stumble, and it judges you all.

fail.text: {actor} stumbles on the words. The god is angered, and the hall throws you out.

partial.text: The god accepts the rite and lets you pass.

success.text: The god hears its old rite and opens the burial chamber with a touch of its staff.

options.label: Climb past it while it speaks
options.description: Dangerous, but no judgement.

fail.text: The staff sweeps {actor} off the throne, and you retreat.

partial.text: You slip past as it turns.

success.text: {actor} is past it and at the door before it ends its question.

start.text: The braziers flare. The gilded coffin opens, and the king steps out, wrapped in linen and gold, while his spear-bearers rise from the lesser coffins. Dust and despair roll from him like a wind.

options.label: Fight the king
options.description: Steel against the dead king and his spear-bearers.

fail.text: His rotting fist withers {actor}.

partial.text: A long fight in the dark, with his curse upon you all.

success.text: {actor} breaks through his spear-bearers and cuts deep into the linen.

options.label: Throw the burial salts and say the rites
options.description: It works, but it means standing at arm's length.

fail.text: The salt scatters wide, and his spear-bearers drive {actor} back.

partial.text: A handful hits. He staggers, and his fist finds {actor}.

success.text: {actor} throws salt in his face and speaks the rites. He reels, but every handful is within his reach.

options.label: Read his true name from the wall
options.description: The carved signs hold his name.

fail.text: {actor} reads too slowly, and the king strikes.

partial.text: {actor} finds part of it, but not enough.

success.text: {actor} speaks the first half of his name. He flinches, and his guard drops.

options.label: Burn him with oil and flame
options.description: Uses 1 alchemicals. A sure blow, once.

outcome.text: He burns like a torch, and claws on as he burns.

win.text: The king crumbles into dust in his gilded coffin, and his spear-bearers fall with him.

lose.text: His despair breaks you. You flee the burial hall and do not look back.

start.text: Something pale and many-armed rises from the depths of the pool, glowing as it comes, and it screams.

options.label: Fight it in the water
options.description: Battle it among the crystal spikes.

fail.text: Its arms drag {actor} onto the crystal spikes. You pull them off and retreat.

partial.text: A thrashing fight in the cold, and the spikes cut everyone.

success.text: {actor} hacks through its arms, and it sinks, dimming.

options.label: Haul out onto the rocks
options.description: Get out of the water before it reaches you.

fail.text: {actor} is last out, and the spikes find them. You turn back.

partial.text: You scramble out, cut and soaked, as it lashes at the rocks.

success.text: {actor} hauls everyone out before it reaches you.

options.label: Douse your light and lie still
options.description: Wait it out in the cold.

outcome.text: It hunts the glow, not you. After a long, freezing wait it sinks again.

start.text: The gate ahead is shut. The side rooms open round it, but as you look, the blue urns flare and the bones on the right begin to stir.

options.label: Pick the middle gate
options.description: The quick way, if the lock allows.

fail.text: The lock is warded. A blue bolt throws {actor} across the hall, and the gate stays shut.

partial.text: It opens, slowly, while the dead close in.

success.text: {actor} has it open, and the dead never reach the bars.

options.label: Go through the coffin room
options.description: Fewer foes, but strong ones.

fail.text: Four tall dead step from the coffins. One nearly takes {actor}'s head, and you fall back out of the hall.

partial.text: A hard fight against four armoured dead.

success.text: {actor} smashes the urns, and the dead fall back into dust.

options.label: Go through the bone heap
options.description: Many weak foes. It wears you down.

fail.text: The bones keep coming. They drag {actor} down, and you barely get them out.

partial.text: You wade through rising skeletons, tiring.

success.text: {actor} clears a path through the bones before they can rise.

start.text: The roar builds until the stones shake. A living blaze pours out of the cleft and takes the shape of a towering figure of flame.

options.label: Fight the fire
options.description: Stand and beat down the blaze, if you can bear the heat.

fail.text: It wraps {actor} in flame, and you flee the heat.

partial.text: A scorching fight among the stalagmites.

success.text: {actor} breaks it apart, and it gutters back into the rock.

options.label: Hide behind the stalagmites
options.description: Wait among the stone teeth while it rages. Your heat may give you away.

fail.text: It finds {actor} by their heat, and you run.

partial.text: It roars about the cave, burning you in passing, and returns to the cleft.

success.text: {actor} keeps you hidden in the stone teeth until it sinks back.

options.label: Drench it
options.description: Uses 3 water.

outcome.text: Steam fills the cave. It dies with a hiss, and you are scalded.

start.text: The lines of light pulse in a slow pattern. Where they touch, the air cracks with cold.

options.label: Learn the pattern
options.description: Read the rhythm of the lines and walk in step with it.

fail.text: {actor} steps on a living line and freezes to the floor. You pry them loose and turn back.

partial.text: You cross in the dark beats.

success.text: {actor} reads the pattern and leads you across in step.

options.label: Leap from pillar to pillar
options.description: Stay off the floor altogether. A slip is costly.

fail.text: {actor} slips and lands across a line. You drag them back out.

partial.text: You cross, mostly in the air.

success.text: {actor} goes first and catches each of the others.

options.label: Walk straight through
options.description: Everyone pays.

outcome.text: The cold bites to the bone, but you are across.

start.text: The lightning gathers on the bier. A knight in black armour rises from it, a sword of violet fire in its fist: the champion of the last test. The lightning in the floor rises with its blade.

options.label: Fight it
options.description: Meet its violet blade head-on. The lightning joins in.

fail.text: The violet blade carves {actor} open, and the lightning leaps to the rest.

partial.text: A long, terrible exchange in the crackling vault.

success.text: {actor} batters through its guard and dents the black helm.

options.label: Draw it over the live veins
options.description: The lightning hurts it. It hurts you too.

fail.text: The vein flares under you all, and it misses nothing.

partial.text: The vein flares under the champion, and under you.

success.text: {actor} leads it onto a live vein, and the lightning throws it down. It throws you down too.

options.label: Read the lightning veins
options.description: Learn how it is fed, and cut it off.

fail.text: {actor} steps on a vein, and the floor throws them down.

partial.text: The pattern shifts as you watch.

success.text: {actor} sees how the champion draws strength from the veins, and how to cut it off.

options.label: Read a scroll of banishing
options.description: Uses 1 arcana. A sure blow, once.

outcome.text: The champion is torn half into the dark, and comes back weaker. The lightning lashes out as it goes.

win.text: The champion's helm falls from its shoulders, and the armour comes apart in violet smoke. The bier goes dark.

lose.text: The violet blade drives you back through the gauntlet. The dead let you go.

start.text: Thin, soot-black miners look up from the fire. They are slaves of the forge, and they know you aren't.

options.label: Rouse them to revolt
options.description: Allies, or an alarm.

fail.text: One of them screams for the guards. You get out before they come.

partial.text: They won't fight, but they won't tell either.

success.text: {actor} lights a fire in them. They will rise when the alarm goes, and the guards will be busy.

options.label: Keep them quiet with threats
options.description: Fear keeps mouths shut, for a while. They will not thank you.

fail.text: One bolts for the halls. The forge will know, and you get out while you can.

partial.text: They stay quiet, but they hate you for it.

success.text: They nod, eyes down. Nobody will say a word.

options.label: Share your food with them
options.description: Uses 2 food.

outcome.text: They eat like wolves, and whisper the way past the guards.

start.text: Two fire giants in soot-stained aprons look up from their counting, and reach for the hammers on the table.

options.label: Fight them among the tables
options.description: Two giants, two hammers. A brutal fight.

fail.text: A hammer blow crushes {actor} into the boards. You drag them out of the forge.

partial.text: A crashing fight, coins flying everywhere.

success.text: {actor} brings the first down, and the second flees for the forge.

options.label: Offer to 'count' with them
options.description: Talk your way to the table. Fire giants hate a thief.

fail.text: They know a thief when they see one, and run you out.

partial.text: They let you go, but they keep a hand on their hammers.

success.text: {actor} has them arguing over the numbers, and you slip a handful off the table on the way out.

options.label: Roll the barrels into them
options.description: Knock them off their feet before they swing.

fail.text: {actor} is caught between barrel and table. You retreat.

partial.text: One goes down under the barrels; the other fights.

success.text: The barrels bowl them over and you finish it fast.

start.text: Serpent-bodied creatures of living flame coil round the vats, tending the fires. They hiss, and the furnaces roar.

options.label: Fight them at the vats
options.description: Hand to hand with living flame.

fail.text: A burning coil wraps {actor}. You pull them free and retreat.

partial.text: A scorching fight among the cranks.

success.text: {actor} spears the first and topples the next into its own vat.

options.label: Tip a vat with its crank
options.description: A flood of molten metal settles it, one way or another.

fail.text: The crank sticks; molten copper spills on {actor}. You flee.

partial.text: The vat tips and catches some of them.

success.text: Molten copper floods across the floor and the tenders flee.

options.label: Creep round behind the slag heaps
options.description: Slip past in the heat and shadow. Your warmth may betray you.

fail.text: The heat gives {actor} away, and the salamanders chase you out.

partial.text: You get past, half-cooked.

success.text: {actor} finds a cool way round behind the heaps.

start.text: The drake hauls on its chain and roars. It is one of the dragon's get, young and furious.

options.label: Kill it before the noise carries
options.description: Fast and bloody, before the forge hears.

fail.text: Its fire washes over {actor}, and you fall back.

partial.text: A roaring, burning fight in the stockade.

success.text: {actor} gets inside its reach and ends it.

options.label: Loose its chain toward the forge
options.description: Its rage will draw the guards, if it goes the right way.

fail.text: It turns on {actor} first, and you flee.

partial.text: It runs wild through the camp, and you slip past in the chaos.

success.text: It bolts for the forge, roaring, and every guard runs after it.

options.label: Soak yourselves at the trough and run past
options.description: Uses 1 water.

outcome.text: Its fire steams off your wet cloaks. You are burned, but past.

start.text: The heat on the bridge is like an open oven. The stones are cracked, and lava bubbles up beneath the arch.

options.label: Run it
options.description: Dash through the heat. Quick, if the stones hold.

fail.text: A stone gives under {actor}, and the lava licks their legs. You turn back.

partial.text: You cross, scorched and gasping.

success.text: {actor} sets a pace through the heat and you make the far side.

options.label: Walk it slowly, testing every stone
options.description: Careful steps, slow and exhausting in the heat.

fail.text: The heat is too much for {actor}, and you turn back.

partial.text: A slow, cooking walk.

success.text: {actor} finds the cool lee of the parapet, and you cross whole.

options.label: Wrap yourselves in soaked cloth
options.description: Uses 2 water.

outcome.text: The cloth steams dry on the way, but you arrive whole.

start.text: The dragon is waiting for you, coiled on its own image. It laughs, and the cave shakes. 'Thieves. You'll do for supper.' It spreads its wings over the lava lake and comes for you.

options.label: Fight the dragon
options.description: Stand on the island and trade blows with it.

fail.text: Its jaws close on {actor}.

partial.text: A desperate exchange on the island, and its fire licks everyone.

success.text: {actor} drives a blade under its scales. It roars and pulls back.

options.label: Strike from behind the pillars
options.description: The pillars hide you. They do not keep out the fire.

fail.text: Its breath finds you all in the open.

partial.text: You scatter as the fire comes, and the stone runs hot.

success.text: {actor} slips out from behind stone and strikes its flank. Its breath fills the cave all the same.

options.label: Tear its wing and ground it
options.description: Ground it, and it is open to your blades.

fail.text: {actor} leaps and misses, and its tail sweeps them across the island.

partial.text: {actor} clings to its wing and drops away.

success.text: {actor} rips through its wing, and it crashes down on the island, roaring.

options.label: Read your scrolls against it
options.description: Uses 2 arcana. A sure blow, once.

outcome.text: Spell after spell tears into it. It burns you as it reels.

win.text: The dragon falls into its own lake, and the lava closes over it. Its gold is yours.

lose.text: Its fire drives you off the island. You flee the forge across the bridges, carrying each other.

start.text: Two bands of iron spikes cross the passage, sunk in slots in the floor. As you watch they stab up and drop back, one band and then the other, in a slow beat. Bones lie in the gap between them.

options.label: Time the beat and go through
options.description: Watch the rhythm and step between the strikes.

fail.text: {actor} misjudges the beat, and the spikes punch up through a boot. You drag them back to the cave and bind the wound there.

partial.text: You cross in pairs on the beat. One of you is a heartbeat slow, and bleeds for it.

success.text: {actor} calls the beat, and you cross between strikes without a scratch.

options.label: Leap the bands
options.description: Jump both bands. Not everyone jumps well.

fail.text: {actor} clears the first band and lands short of the second. The spikes take a leg, and you haul them back the way you came.

partial.text: You jump them one at a time. Not everyone lands clean.

success.text: {actor} leaps both bands and drops a rope back for the rest.

options.label: Jam the slots with timber
options.description: Uses 1 timber.

outcome.text: You wedge beams across the slots. The spikes grind against the wood and stop, and you walk through. The beams will not last for the way back.

start.text: In the far corner of the hall, inside a quarter-circle of violet runes, a body wrapped in grave-cloth sits against the wall. Its head turns as you come in. 'Another candidate,' it whispers. 'Let me out, and I will tell you how the next test is passed.'

options.label: Break the runes and free it
options.description: Trust it and break its prison. The runes bite.

fail.text: The runes flare as you scuff them, and violet fire runs up {actor}'s arms. The thing in the corner laughs as you stagger back to the spikes.

partial.text: The circle breaks with a crack that burns your hands. The thing crawls out, mutters 'the shadows are the fire's', and is gone down the hall.

success.text: {actor} unpicks the runes one by one. The candidate rises, bows, and tells you plainly: in the next hall the shadows are made by the fire, so master the fire and you master them.

options.label: Question it from outside the circle
options.description: Talk, but keep your distance. It lies.

fail.text: It talks and talks, and while it talks the runes creep across the floor and take hold of {actor}. You drag them free and fall back to the spikes.

partial.text: You sift half a truth from its lies: something about the fire in the next hall.

success.text: {actor} catches it in its own lies until it gives up the secret of the next hall. You leave it in its circle.

outcome.text: You keep to the far wall. The runes lash out as you pass, and their cold stays in your bones.

start.text: Six braziers on iron stands burn down the walls of a wide hall and throw your shadows long across the floor. Then the shadows go on moving after you have stopped, and turn, and reach for you.

options.label: Fight the shadows
options.description: Steel against shadow. It may not cut.

fail.text: Blades pass through them. Cold hands sink into {actor}'s chest, and you carry them back up the hall, grey and shaking.

partial.text: You hack the shadows apart, and they leave a chill in all of you.

success.text: {actor} drives them back into the walls with steel and fury, and the hall goes still.

options.label: Snuff the braziers one by one
options.description: Kill the light and you kill the shadows. Each flame is a long reach.

fail.text: {actor} reaches for the third brazier, and a shadow takes the arm that holds the lid. You fall back into the corridor.

partial.text: Brazier by brazier the hall goes dark, and the shadows with it. The last one fights for its light.

success.text: {actor} darts from stand to stand. With the last flame out, there are no shadows left to move.

options.label: Burn oil to flood the hall with light
options.description: Uses 1 fuel.

outcome.text: You pour oil across the floor and fire it. In the white blaze the shadows shrink to nothing, and you cross the hall with your eyebrows singed.

start.text: The pit is as warm as a bread oven. Pale eggs lie heaped in its corners, and in the scorched hollows of its floor a dozen drake hatchlings, each as big as a hound, lift their heads and hiss.

options.label: Fight through the hatchlings
options.description: Cut a path through the brood.

fail.text: They come out of every hollow at once. {actor} goes down under three of them, and you drag them out of the pit, burned and bitten.

partial.text: A snapping, scorching fight across the pit floor.

success.text: {actor} kills the biggest, and the rest scatter back to their hollows, hissing.

options.label: Creep round the rim
options.description: Quiet steps past a pit of teeth.

fail.text: An egg rolls under {actor}'s foot and cracks. The whole brood rises screeching, and you run back the way you came.

partial.text: You are halfway round when they scent you, and you run the rest with teeth at your heels.

success.text: {actor} leads you round the rim behind the hollows. The hatchlings never stir.

options.label: Snatch an egg on the way
options.description: A dragon egg is worth a fortune. Its brood knows it.

fail.text: {actor} gets a hand on an egg, and the brood is on them at once. You drop it and flee the pit.

partial.text: {actor} comes away with an egg and a scorched arm, and the brood chases you out the far side. A dragon egg is worth its weight in gold.

success.text: {actor} lifts an egg from the heap and is gone before the brood knows it. A dragon egg is worth its weight in gold.

start.text: At the east furnace two azers, their beards braided flame, are tipping the great vat into a line of crucibles along the wall. One of them sees you and swings the long pouring pole round, the crucible on its end brimming with white-hot metal.

options.label: Rush them before they pour
options.description: Close the gap before the pole swings round.

fail.text: The crucible tips. Molten metal splashes across {actor}, and you drag them back from the furnace.

partial.text: You close in through a hail of spattering metal and beat them down.

success.text: {actor} is on them before the pole comes round, and the crucible crashes harmlessly into its rack.

options.label: Say the counters sent you to check the weights
options.description: A made-up errand. The azers know their own.

fail.text: The azers know every face in the forge. They pour, and you flee back toward the pens.

partial.text: They let you by, but their eyes follow you, and soon the whole forge knows there are strangers about.

success.text: {actor} grumbles about short weight so well that the azers hurry to reweigh the moulds and wave you through.

options.label: Throw a flask of frost-salt into the vat
options.description: Uses 1 alchemicals.

outcome.text: The vat skins over with a crack like thunder and belches choking steam. In the cloud you get past the azers, scalded.

start.text: Gold coin lies knee-deep across the cave floor. In it stand blackened shapes that were once men, burned where they stood with their hands still full. A rune is cut into the rock above the heap, and it glows as you come near.

options.label: Read the ward and slip it
options.description: Turn the ward aside, and take your time with the gold.

fail.text: {actor} speaks the wrong word. The rune flares, fire runs across the gold toward you, and you get out of the cave with your clothes alight.

partial.text: The ward dims long enough to cross the cave and fill a purse. It snaps back as the last of you leaves.

success.text: {actor} turns the ward aside. You walk through the gold and take a handful each.

options.label: Grab a fistful and run
options.description: Quick hands, a smaller purse, and a race against the rune.

fail.text: {actor} stoops for the gold, and the rune burns. You flee the cave beating out the flames.

partial.text: You scoop and run. The fire licks at your heels all the way across.

success.text: {actor} is across the heap and out with full hands before the rune wakes.

options.label: Climb round the wall, touching nothing

outcome.text: Hand over hand along the hot rock, never touching a coin. It is long, sweltering work.
